Name.description: The name of the PushTopic, used as the CometD channel name (/topic/{Name})

Query.description: The SOQL query that defines which records to monitor. Must be a SELECT query on a single SObject.

ApiVersion.description: The API version for this PushTopic

IsActive.description: Whether this PushTopic is actively generating events

NotifyForFields.description: Which field changes trigger notifications: Select (fields in SELECT), Where (fields in WHERE), Referenced (both), All (any field)

NotifyForOperationCreate.description: Whether to generate events when matching records are created

NotifyForOperationUpdate.description: Whether to generate events when matching records are updated

NotifyForOperationDelete.description: Whether to generate events when matching records are deleted

NotifyForOperationUndelete.description: Whether to generate events when matching records are undeleted
